fields.claim: No Zylon/PBO film exists as a sourced product: no modulus, toughness, puncture or tear data. The tear lengths use other films' toughness and a projected modulus. The film is also unprotected from daylight (35 percent strength after six months).
fields.needed_to_ground: A built 0/90 PBO film with barrier, tested for puncture, slit tear under biaxial load and UV.
